title: fix-bug.md says stash may run freely, contradicting CLAUDE.md's owned-path stash rule
outcome: fix-bug.md says stash may run freely, contradicting CLAUDE.md's owned-path stash rule
acceptance: .claude/commands/fix-bug.md no longer lists stash among git commands that 'may be executed freely'; it defers to CLAUDE.md's owned-path stash rule (git stash push -u -m <unique-tag> -- <owned-paths>, never bare git stash or git stash pop)
The change lands under the instruction-change conditions (a), (b) and (c), with a clean review pair and full gate
